title: diplacus kelloggii
intro: Diplacus kelloggii, commonly known as Western Monkey Flower, is a perennial wildflower native to the western coast of North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Diplacus kelloggii include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
